recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if the work group opens a separate request for search parameters or narrative guidance beyond FHIR-31593's datatype choices.
issue_request: FHIR-31593 asked to align Ingredient.substance.strength.presentation and concentration with Medication.ingredient.strength[x] by allowing Ratio, CodeableConcept, and Quantity, while allowing Ratio and Quantity but not CodeableConcept for high-limit and reference-strength values.
initial_application: Upstream commit c31cf6846019e402344efec66a1782bc32968829 explicitly applied FHIR#31593 by making presentation and concentration choice elements with Ratio, CodeableConcept, and Quantity and by allowing Ratio and Quantity on high-limit/reference-strength values.
additional_context: MedicinalProductIngredient is now mapped to active Ingredient in source/fhir.ini. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-31821, already represented on the combined branch, removed separate high-limit fields in favor of RatioRange/Range choices; that change supersedes the old high-limit element names without undoing FHIR-31593's coded/quantity strength semantics. Medication and MedicationKnowledge still expose the Ratio, CodeableConcept, Quantity choice set cited by the issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because Ingredient.substance.strength.presentation[x] and concentration[x] include Ratio, RatioRange, CodeableConcept, Quantity, and Range, while referenceStrength.strength[x] includes Ratio, RatioRange, Quantity, and Range and excludes CodeableConcept.

related_jiras.note: Replaced old high-limit Ingredient strength fields with RatioRange/Range choices and was already published on the combined branch as e8e6cbf17a2a52792cbd9b5f8fe52c5775783268.
Added Quantity to Medication.ingredient.strength, providing the Medication choice model that FHIR-31593 cited for Ingredient alignment.
